source: NOAA WaveWatch III via Open-Meteo Marine API

quality.atmospheric_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API (temperature_2m, pressure_msl, 10 m wind)
quality.notes: NOAA NOMADS WW3 GRIB endpoints returned 403 from this environment and no GRIB2 decoder was installed. Open-Meteo serves the same NOAA WW3 fields as JSON, which we consume directly. The API requires equal-length lat/lon arrays; we fetch a 17x17 square over the display bbox and bilinearly interpolate to the 17x21 display grid. Atmospheric 10-m wind is pulled from api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast on the same grid+timeline.
quality.co_tidal_source: NASA GSFC GOT4.10c M2 harmonic field with station-calibrated datum offset; CO-OPS observations are validation only

tide_benchmark.correction: global median CO-OPS prediction minus GOT4.10c M2 model

tide_harmonic_source.provider: NASA GSFC Goddard Ocean Tide GOT4.10c
tide_harmonic_source.method: regional bilinear extraction from global harmonic atlas
tide_harmonic_source.calibration_reference: current eight CO-OPS station prediction curves
